column1: # BK7259 secureboot_overwrite_no_en partition table (8MB) - single-slot OVERWRITE.
# Unlike secureboot_xip (which keeps twin primary_*/secondary_* A/B slots)
# OVERWRITE strategy runs from ONE execution slot (primary_all) plus a dedicated
#   1. Device receives the compressed+signed ota.bin and writes it verbatim into
#   2. On reset BL2 (MCUboot OVERWRITE_ONLY) reads `ota` block-by-block
#   3. `ota_control` holds the power-fail resume / anti-brick journal.
#   - primary_*          : folded by the packer into virtual `primary_all`
#                          once by BL2 (EC-P256). This is the single execution slot.
#   - ota                : staging area for the received compressed image. Name
#                          NO bin is packed into it; it is filled at runtime.
#   - NO boot_param      : A/B ping-pong is XIP-only; OVERWRITE uses ota_control.
#   - primary_* code partitions are placed AFTER bl2 (verified by BL2).
#     requires the partition immediately before `ota` to end on a 64K boundary
#   - NO secondary_* partitions (OVERWRITE runs a single slot).
# bl1_control must be a CODE partition so the secure packer AES-encrypts it and
# writes the BootROM 'BK.SB' magic at offset 0x100 (which selects secure boot).
# Kept out of the application numbering by bk_flash_partition._part_adapter.
